meta.note: Most recent non-empty value per country; values older than minYear are dropped. Scores use fixed anchors, see transform.

air_quality.measure: PM2.5 air pollution, mean annual exposure

internet_speed.transform: Share online divided by 10 (100% = 10). Measures access, not speed.

local_job_market.transform: Log scale: $2,000 = 0, $100,000 or more = 10. An economy-wide average, not wages for your job.

healthcare_quality.transform: 55 years = 0, 85 years = 10, linear. A health outcome, not a direct measure of healthcare.

cost_of_living.measure: Price level ratio (PPP conversion factor / market exchange rate; USA = 1)

nature_forests_greenery.transform: 0% = 0, 60% or more = 10, linear. Counts forest only, not parks or farmland.
